name: C#
run: DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 dotnet run -c Release --nologo -v q
needs: .NET 6 SDK or newer (built with .NET 8) and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: The library is looked for in `$PEEP_LIB`, then the current directory, then the program directory.
`Read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: demo: decodes the test files and prints checksums
